title: Pithyx catalog v1
description: `catalog.json` at the root of a catalog repository (D328), on `master` and copied unchanged to the branches `catalog-next` and `catalog`. It names the catalog; the apps are in `index.json` of those branches (`index.v1.schema.json`). Readers ignore fields they do not know, so a new optional field is a minor change; anything else raises `catalogVersion`, which a box refuses when it does not know it.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors. Ignored by the box.

id.description: The catalog's id: its owner's domain reversed plus a name, 3 to 5 parts like an app id (D302), for example `com.mueller.apps`. A box keeps the catalog in `/var/lib/pithyx/catalogs/<id>/`. `org.pithyx.*` is reserved for the project's catalogs `org.pithyx.official` and `org.pithyx.community`.

name.description: The catalog's name in the Store, keyed by BCP 47 language tag; `en` is required.

description.description: One or two sentences about the catalog, keyed by BCP 47 language tag; `en` is required.

homepage.description: The catalog's repository or website, shown in the Store's settings.

images.description: Where the catalog's CI pushes the images it builds: a registry and a path without a tag, for example `ghcr.io/pithyx/apps`. An app's service `<service>` of version `<version>` is pushed as `<images>/<id>/<service>:<version>` and linked only by digest.
